title: Enterprise AI Platform End-to-End Selection & 2026 Capability Breakthrough Radar: Serverless PAYGO vs. Provisioned PTU vs. Self-Hosted K8s TCO Crossover & AI Gateway Comparison (APIM / Envoy GIE / LiteLLM / Kong / Higress)

tiers.tier: Tier 1: Unmanaged Direct 100% Serverless PAYGO APIs (No AI Gateway, Frequent 429 Throttling)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Early-stage prototypes (<300M tokens/month or <20% average utilization)

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Single-Tier Python Proxy (LiteLLM) + 100% Peak-Sized Cloud PTU (No Self-Hosted Offload)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Mid-sized teams relying solely on proprietary frontier APIs with steady daytime traffic

tiers.tier: Tier 3: 100% Self-Hosted K8s + Round-Robin Ingress (Cache-Blind Routing & Peak Overprovisioning)
tiers.recommended_scenario: Suboptimal self-hosted K8s missing KV-aware Endpoint Picker (EPP) and cloud spillover

tiers.tier: Tier 4 (Recommended): Dual-Layer Gateway (North-South APIM/Kong + East-West Envoy GIE EPP) + Hybrid K8s/PTU/PAYGO
tiers.recommended_scenario: Milestone #400 Enterprise AI Platform standard (-88.1% annual TCO & 91.8% KV cache hit rate)
